model.stratum: Based changing-state gradient norm and localized weak-drift transport, strong operator-graph recovery and weak graph-limit inclusion, plus fixed-input resolvent gradient transport. Conditional integration by parts identifies weak components and the actual normalized eigen-energy identity prevents norm loss. No direct cross-source derivative subtraction, pointwise gradient convergence, unit-ball operator norm or path-space comparison is inferred.
missing_constructors: stationary continuous-path source diffusion and finite-source path-law comparison
classical smooth drift and C(X) cylinder generator core if sought
model.next_falsifier: Weak components or full gradient norms fail to converge, a within-source multiplier is silently replaced by a cross-source coordinate copy, or strong core-value transport does not support actual graph recovery.
